comments.text:
I would recommend the PC versions for all of the games that have PC versions.

Grand Theft Auto has a Ready2Play version that will run the original GTA, London 1961, and London 1969.

GTA 2 looks the best with the PC version with thirteenAG's widescreen fix, the frontend fix, and ginput.

GTA3, Vice City, and San Andreas should be the PC versions with ginput and thirteenAG's widescreen fixes.
